ABOUT MGAA

A multidisciplinary firm built around one priority — yours.

Medez-Galanto & Associates (MGAA) is a leading professional services firm providing expert solutions in regulatory compliance, taxation, external and internal audit, corporate governance, and financial advisory.

Driven by our core commitment, we help organizations navigate complex statutory environments, mitigate operational risks, and maintain full compliance with government regulations — across every agency and every filing deadline that matters.

OUR COMMITMENT

"Your Business, Our Priority."

CORE AREAS OF EXPERTISE

Compliance support across every function that touches it

From BIR filings to boardroom governance, our practice areas cover the full compliance lifecycle.

Tax Compliance & Advisory

Navigating BIR regulations, avoiding tax assessments, managing compliance audits, and strategic tax planning.

Regulatory & Agency Compliance

Streamlining compliance with BIR, SEC, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, DOLE, and Local Government Units.

Audit & Assurance

Comprehensive audit readiness, internal controls optimization, and independent financial verification.

Corporate Governance & Risk

Building resilient organizational frameworks to ensure long-term business sustainability.
